children: Qiddiya City has signed Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with five major travel and tourism service providers as it moves to strengthen visitor access to its destinations and experiences.

The agreements were signed with Al Faris International Travel and Tourism, Travel Destinations Solutions, Al Matar Commercial Services Company, AlMosafer Travel and Tourism Company, and Fursan Travel and Tourism Company.

The partnerships form part of Qiddiya City’s strategy to expand its network across the travel and tourism sector and enhance its readiness to welcome visitors from Saudi Arabia and international markets.

Under the MoUs, Qiddiya City will work with the companies to develop more integrated and flexible solutions covering the visitor journey, from trip planning and booking to travel arrangements, arrival and access to destinations and experiences.

Qiddiya City will draw on the partners’ expertise, booking infrastructure and commercial networks to help streamline the visitor experience and provide more efficient options for accessing its attractions.
The agreements also support Qiddiya City’s broader plans to build partnerships across the tourism ecosystem and develop integrated tourism solutions as its destinations prepare to welcome visitors.
Qiddiya City is being developed as a global destination bringing together entertainment, sport and culture, with experiences built around the concept of the “Power of Play.”

The latest agreements add to Qiddiya City’s efforts to establish a connected tourism ecosystem and create easier pathways for visitors to discover and experience its growing portfolio of destinations.

title: ZAWYA: Saudi: Qiddiya City partners with travel companies to enhance visitor access
